uncited: It serves as the foundational engine for subsequent optimizations such as FlashGS and Mobile-GS.
*   **Input:** A set of 3D Gaussians defined by position $\mathbf{p}_k$, covariance $\Sigma_k$, opacity $\alpha_k$, and spherical harmonics coefficients for color.
The method relies on a structured layout of Gaussian attributes to facilitate efficient matrix operations.
**Attribute Loading:** Load Gaussian attributes from global memory into shared memory or registers.
**Projection:** Transform 3D Gaussian centers to screen space using the Model-View-Projection (MVP) matrix.
**Splat Rasterization:** For each pixel, determine the contribution of overlapping Gaussians.
This step efficiently computes the final color and depth values by leveraging GPU tensor cores or optimized shader instructions.
*   **Time Complexity:** $O(N \cdot T)$, where $N$ is the number of Gaussians and $T$ is the number of tiles.
